gaps.explanation: detail[] is only the Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Cash Basis - TOTAL PRIMARY GOVERNMENT (p16-17), one combined schedule for governmental and utility funds; its lines were tagged governmental or business-type by label, but the printed lines mix both. Governmental-tagged lines (p16): Property Taxes 86,391 + Federal Receipts 54,575 + Pro-Rate 213 + Highway Allocation and Incentive 95,128 + Motor Vehicle Fees 6,997 + Municipal Equalization 31,444 + State Other 138,116 + Motor Vehicle Taxes 7,416 + Local Option Sales Tax 141,149 + In Lieu 0 = 561,429. Statement (p7 Total column) 640,101. Federal Receipts 54,575 includes the Water Fund Grant Proceeds 44,778 (business-type, p12), so governmental receipts in those lines = 516,651; the other 640,101 - 516,651 = 123,450 governmental receipts sit inside the single printed line 'Local Receipts: Other' 1,412,104, which was tagged business-type: Franchise 1,900 + Fees, Permits and Licenses 1,868 + Building Rent 15,931 + Park Fees 4,301 + Pool Receipts 2,769 + Farm Income 28,521 + Interest 5,566 + Donations 10,182 + Miscellaneous 42,412 = 113,450, plus 10,000 of the Grants 143,750 (statement Homestead 8,516 + Property Tax Credit 5,647 + Grants 143,750 - 9,797 federal = 148,116 vs State Other 138,116). 123,450 - 44,778 = 78,672 = gap. A per-fund fix (one line per governmental fund column, per the 2026-10-27 per-fund rule) is not possible: the left halves of the governmental funds statement (printed pp19, 22, 24, 52: row labels and the General, Street, Airport, Community Development columns) are not in the Auditor's PDF (CLAUDE.md: Sargent_FY2022 cannot be re-trimmed); only Community Center (8,056) and Medical Center (6,150) columns are in the trim (p7), and adding just those would be a partial fix. No fix.

Budget schedule p17 governmental disbursements: General Government 94,143 + Public Safety 96,283 + Public Works 222,821 + Public Health and Social Services 1,947 + Airport 79,433 + Culture and Recreation 133,257 + Community Development 117,299 = 745,183 (cash budgetary basis, capital outlay inside the functions). Statement p8 Total expenditures 689,866. Difference 55,317 = the (50,000) third other-financing row on p8 (loan advances, paid out of Community Development: 117,299 budget vs 67,299 statement) + 5,317 transfers out that the budget counts as disbursements but the p8 Adjustments column nets to 0 (Transfers out row: Adjustments 5,317, Total 0). 689,866 + 50,000 + 5,317 = 745,183. No fix.

Budget schedule p16 'Transfers In' 40,517 is a primary-government gross figure; statement p8 Total column transfers in 35,000 is net of the Adjustments column (5,317). 40,517 = 35,000 + 5,317 (governmental interfund transfer eliminated by the Adjustments column, p8) + 200 (Sewer Fund Transfers 200, business-type, p12). No fix.

Business-type-tagged detail line is the single printed budget line 'Local Receipts: Other' 1,412,104 (p16, total primary government, cash basis). Statement (pp11-12): Total Operating Revenues 1,219,364 + Grant Proceeds 44,778 + Interest Income 3,866 = 1,268,008. Gap -144,096 = -123,450 (governmental receipts inside the same printed line, see governmental revenue) + 44,778 (Water Fund grant carried in the governmental-tagged Federal Receipts line) - 65,424 (cash receipts in the budget line that the statements do not report as revenue; 63,561 matches the fourth governmental other-financing row on p8, loan repayments; the remaining 1,863 is not identifiable from the trim). -123,450 + 44,778 - 65,424 = -144,096. The line is one printed amount and cannot be split; replacing it with the proprietary fund columns would drop the 123,450 governmental receipts from detail and double-count the 44,778 grant (still inside Federal Receipts). No fix.

Budget schedule p17 Business-Type Activities (cash budgetary basis): Electric 725,242 + Solid Waste 94,016 + Sewer 158,672 + Water 130,683 = 1,108,613. Statement (accrual): Total Operating Expenses 981,776 (p11, includes Depreciation 136,198) + Interest Expense 11,933 (p12) = 993,709. The cash budget includes capital purchases and debt principal and excludes depreciation. Left unfixed together with the other lines of this combined schedule (see business-type revenue: the schedule cannot be split cleanly by fund type in this report).
